items.title: Roy McCurdy interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: Tommy Williams, myself, Grachan Moncur III... and that was it, and Art and Benny and myself.

ctx.x: Who else was on the band at that time?

Harold Mabern was the piano player. The bass player was a Tommy Williams — I don’t know if you know Tommy Williams — he was a wonderful, wonderful bass player. And he wound up, he was driving a taxi cab in New York a lot, you know, instead of playing steady. But he just played so great. Tommy Williams, myself, Grachan Moncur III, the trombone player, and that was it, and Art and Benny and myself.
Did that band record? © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -4-
